# Creator Partnerships

`creator-partnerships` · v1.0.0 · Execute · Growth, Retention & RevOps
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/creator-partnerships/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Which creators reach our buyers at the lowest cost, what terms are still missing, and which sponsorships should we keep or drop?

**Inputs:** The creators on your shortlist with their fee, median views, engagements, the share of their audience that fits your buyer and where that share came from, how many recent posts were sponsored and whether they disclose; the terms agreed; afterwards the tracked conversions and survey mentions per creator and your target cost per acquisition

**Output:** The shortlist ranked by cost per thousand people who fit your buyer, with every gap in the data named; the contract terms still missing; and a keep, renegotiate, drop or too-early call per creator

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill creator-partnerships`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/creator-partnerships/resources/creator-fit.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/creator-partnerships/resources/creator-fit.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: not recorded yet.

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- Cost per thousand matched people rests on the creator's median views and audience-match share. If those come from a media kit, not platform analytics, the ranking is the creator's claim.
- Creators are ranked only against each other on your shortlist. No outside benchmark is used, so the cheapest creator on the list can still be poor value.
- Tracked conversions undercount and survey mentions can overlap them, so the true cost sits between the two figures. Under five conversions in total the call is too early.
- The contract check confirms the eight terms are marked agreed. It does not review their wording and is not a legal check of FTC or local disclosure rules.

**Review before acting:** The marketing owner checks each creator's views and audience share against a platform analytics screenshot or export, and reviews disclosure wording and placement in every post before it goes live.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/creator-partnerships](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/creator-partnerships)
